research_population: Public YouTube channel operators and community moderators as described by official platform documents; not a victim survey or individual case audit.

modules.title: Moderating participation
modules.constraints: Settings, moderator roles and available surfaces differ; no control ensures all abusive messages are prevented.

modules.title: Harassment and public-content reporting
modules.constraints: Reports are evaluated under YouTube policy; removal odds, response times and legal outcomes cannot be inferred.

modules.title: Personal privacy and likeness complaints
modules.constraints: The complainant's facts and eligibility matter; do not store private addresses, screenshots of accounts, financial data or identity credentials.

modules.title: Recovering unauthorized account access
modules.constraints: Recovery and removal of abuse require separate processes; potential hacking support is limited by published retention terms.

dated_changes.notes: Automated pause on detection is a protective product control, not proof an account was compromised or a final penalty. Typical review time is not a service guarantee.

recovery_sequence.note: Secure the owning Google Account and all associated delegates using official recovery flows
Review unauthorized videos, account links, descriptions and strikes
Use approved role-scoped permissions instead of sharing login credentials

support_limitations: Official Help states potential hacked-channel support is limited to incidents within nine months due to retention. This is not a guaranteed channel recovery or a universal appeal deadline.
important_separations: Product security pause is not the same as a Community Guidelines strike, permanent termination, account ban or loss of monetization status.
Notification in Studio and typical 24-hour security review are not proof of a compromised account or guaranteed restoration time.
Viewer access to existing uploads can continue even while the account owner cannot publish new videos during the pause.
Google Account security, YouTube channel delegate permissions, and Studio moderation settings protect different attack surfaces.
Platform content reports, privacy complaints, and hacked-account recovery have distinct eligibility and appeal paths.
Never infer harassment, political affiliation, or victim status from public user names, comments, language, gender or audience demographics.
